mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users ( email, password, gender, userName, userRole, nickname, birthDate, profilePhotoUrl, phoneNumber, myTeam, socialProvider, weight, transferNumber, receiveNumber, paneltyPoint, isBlock, isDelete ) VALUES ( #{email}, #{password}, #{gender}, #{userName}, #{userRole}, #{nickname}, #{birthDate}, #{profilePhotoUrl}, #{phoneNumber}, #{myTeam}, #{socialProvider}, #{weight}, #{transferNumber}, #{receiveNumber}, #{paneltyPoint}, #{isBlock}, #{isDelete} )
mapper.select: SELECT email, user_name, nickname, gender, profile_photo_url, my_team, phone_number, user_role, birth_date, transfer_number, receive_number, panelty_point FROM users WHERE email = #{email}
